# Sample Project

A small sample project used as a fixture for the README audit. It exists so the audit
script has a realistic document to score, with a lead paragraph that stays comfortably
under the length guardrail.

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://example.com/sample.git
cd sample
bundle install
```

## Usage

Run the tool against a file:

```bash
ruby scripts/sample.rb input.txt
```

It prints a report and exits non-zero when a check fails.

## Features

- Deterministic output
- No network access
- Plain text report
